### RMIT Vietnam Library's first loyalty program. By joining, students can earn points, track their participation and redeem rewards while engaging with the library community.
![This image showcases the name of the event: "Library Friends", featuring cats as the mascot of the event. There are texts: "Engage in library events", "Collect points" and "Redeem prizes" as instructions to join the program](https://www.rmit.edu.vn/assets/vn/en/assets-for-production/images/libraryvn-site/events/library-friends/library-friends-event-reference.jpg)
## Why join Library Friends
  * Explore the Library Friends calendar to easily see upcoming events and point-earning opportunities.
  * Earn points by participating in library events and activities.
  * Redeem points for exciting gifts and library merchandise.
  * Track your progress through the Library Friends platform. 
  * Climb the leaderboard and see how you rank among active library participants.


## How it works
  1. Join library events and activities.
  2. Submit the point accumulation form after participation.
  3. Check your points using your Student ID.
  4. Redeem rewards when you reach the required points.


![This image showing the calendar of events featured in Library Friends program](https://www.rmit.edu.vn/assets/vn/en/assets-for-production/images/libraryvn-site/events/library-friends/library-friends-calendar.jpg)
### Library Friends calendar
Explore thecalendar to discover upcoming events and point-earning activities throughout the semester.
Each event shows:
  * Event name
  * Date and time 
  * Points you can earn


Participate in these activities to collect points and unlock rewards.
![This image showing how many points the student may get through some illustrations ](https://www.rmit.edu.vn/assets/vn/en/assets-for-production/images/libraryvn-site/events/library-friends/library-friends-checkpoint.jpg)
### Check your points
Use your Student ID to access the Library Friends dashboard and view:
  * Your total points
  * Available rewards
  * Redemption options 


![This image showing the prizes available in the Library Friends program, and how many points each prize values](https://www.rmit.edu.vn/assets/vn/en/assets-for-production/images/libraryvn-site/events/library-friends/library-friends-prizes.jpg)
### Rewards you can unlock
  * Headphones 
  * Tumbler 
  * Handheld Fan 
  * Tote Bag 
  * Card Holder 
  * Lanyard
